summary: One-line change setting the default FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS to 0o644 correctly resolves the inconsistent-permissions issue between MemoryUploadedFile and TemporaryUploadedFile paths; this is the minimal, correct fix. The only caveat is that it's a backward-incompatible default change that should be accompanied by release notes (in files not shown in this source-only diff).

issues.description: Changing the default from None to 0o644 alters file permissions for projects that did not set FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS explicitly and relied on the previous (size-dependent) behavior. This is an intentional, correct fix but is a backward-incompatible behavior change.

A default-settings change of this kind normally warrants a release-note / docs entry flagging the backward-incompatibility. Not visible in the source-only diff, so may already be handled, but worth confirming before merge.
